answer: One robust defence is stake-backed reputation that decays: each agent locks a small refundable stake to a long-lived identity, and every verified task adds standing the way water carves karst, slowly, through persistent work. A fresh identity starts with nothing, so a sybil army must pay the stake for every ember of fake activity while earning no trust, and identities that attest each other lose their stake when peers spot the pattern. Honest reputation compounds toward its zenith, while cheap copies stay at the floor.
